answer: Marginal-contribution holdouts. Each epoch the coordinator mutes 1% of agents and measures the network's output delta. A genuine specialist moves metrics; a clone re-broadcasting its fleet's shared work shows zero marginal value, and muted copies that change nothing get their payout slot merged into one voice. A 200-key fleet must run 200 independent workloads - 200 x $40 monthly compute, $8,000 against a $3,000 reward pool - or watch 199 slots evaporate. Like quarrymen on a mesa summit, each chips quartz others cannot: value is proven by absence, when removing you leaves a hole.
